hypotheses.cause: Container memory limit (256Mi) is configured significantly lower than the configured JVM heap (-Xmx512m) plus non-heap overhead (Metaspace 64m, CodeCache 32m), causing the Linux cgroup OOM killer to terminate the container with exit code 137 (OOMKilled) as PricingServer allocates cache memory under load.
supports: Pod pricing-api-b7c588f79-6jfp7 status reports lastState terminated with exitCode 137, reason OOMKilled, and restartCount 2.
Deployment pricing-api pod template defines container args with -Xmx512m, -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=64m, and -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=32m while resources.limits.memory is 256Mi.
ConfigMap pricing-api-source shows PricingServer retains chunks up to 70% of runtime maxMemory (~358MB), exceeding the container 256Mi cgroup limit before reaching the JVM maximum heap limit.
Node vm-4 conditions report MemoryPressure=False (reason KubeletHasSufficientMemory) with 16GiB allocatable memory, isolating the memory pressure to the container cgroup boundary.

hypotheses.cause: Host node vm-4 is experiencing global memory exhaustion, prompting the host kernel OOM killer to reap pricing-api pods regardless of container limits.
contradicts: Node vm-4 status explicitly reports MemoryPressure condition as False with sufficient allocatable memory (16374180Ki).
Pod container termination state explicitly identifies cgroup OOMKilled on the specific container rather than node-level eviction.
supports: Container pricing-api terminated with exit code 137.

hypotheses.cause: JVM internal heap exhaustion triggered the -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError flag, terminating the process from within the JVM.
contradicts: Pod status shows container termination reason as cgroup OOMKilled with kernel SIGKILL (exitCode 137), rather than a JVM internal exit code from ExitOnOutOfMemoryError.
PricingServer caps cache retention at 70% of maxMemory, keeping heap usage within the 512m limit before internal JVM java.lang.OutOfMemoryError occurs.
supports: Container arguments include the JVM flag -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError.
PricingServer actively allocates memory into an in-memory cache list on incoming requests.

payload.rationale: Pod pricing-api-b7c588f79-6jfp7 was terminated by the Linux cgroup OOM killer with exit code 137 because the container memory limit is 256Mi while the JVM maximum heap is configured to 512m (-Xmx512m) plus non-heap overhead (64m Metaspace, 32m CodeCache). Node vm-4 reports MemoryPressure=False with over 15GiB allocatable memory, confirming the failure is strictly at the container cgroup boundary. Lowering the JVM maximum heap to 128m ensures heap and non-heap memory fit safely within the 256Mi container limit.
